ideas.name: World-State Factorized Targets (WSFT)
ideas.dimension: data/target construction (training objective, non-RL core; optional GRPO reward variant)
ideas.one_liner: Execute B1 program-lattice predicate DAGs against simulator world-state annotations and replace one-hot targets with predicate-factorized distributions: gold 1-eps, soft mass on options sharing k-of-n predicates, U mass when predicate execution is indeterminate.

novelty.claim: No prior work feeds simulator-executed predicate factorization back as a training-target distribution for a single-token direct-answer frozen VLM. PRMs (VisualPRM, StructReward) verify CoT steps; we have no CoT. Neuro-symbolic line (NS-DR/VRDP/CRCG) executes programs at inference to produce answers; we only borrow the executor to build labels.

nearest_neighbors.name: StructReward
nearest_neighbors.difference: structured process rewards derived from LLM, verifying reasoning chains; not simulator-executed, not for CoT-free single-token targets

nearest_neighbors.name: CRCG Think-before-You-Simulate
nearest_neighbors.difference: runs simulation at inference time with explicit reasoning; we use world state only at training time

nearest_neighbors.name: VisualPRM
nearest_neighbors.difference: trained 8B step verifier; needs CoT steps to verify; violates our no-new-heads contract

ideas.gain_mechanism: one-hot cliff forces arbitrary hard splits between near-miss options; graded soft targets teach predicate-level separability

gain_estimate.basis: soft-label distillation literature 2-5pt; frontier VLM 92-95% vs our 74.4% gap concentrated at predicate layer where symbolic methods close it; simulator coverage limited to synthetic families

contract.notes: data/target-side only; model, template, single-token readout unchanged

gates.success: merged relational slice (in/out+motion+start/end) >= +3pt abs; other slices regression <=1pt; ECE not worse
gates.abandon: factorized vs one-hot difference <=0.5pt after 2 seeds

ideas.name: Deliberation-Distilled Decision Priors (D3P)
ideas.one_liner: Distill not the teacher's argmax but the teacher's full option distribution measured under short forced deliberation or counterfactual given-answer hint probes, into the student's single token with zero generated tokens at student time.

novelty.claim: Counterfactual hint-probe teacher distributions (given-answer probing) as distillation targets for single-token VLM decisions not found in retrieval; System-2 distillation / implicit CoT are text-side or generative and distill rationales, not probe-conditioned distributions.

ideas.name: Perception-Marginalized Decision (PMD)

novelty.claim: Perception-side TTS exists only as token-rich decomposition (PTS) or world-model coupling (MindJourney); learned mixture-of-views into a single-token readout with calibrated view weights not found; TTS survey marks perception-side TTS as open gap.
